pairing_verified: labels and donor arrays element-wise identical across arms (see per-pair n_cells and skipped)

42.resampling: donor-stratified, cells with replacement within donor
42.ci_method: per-seed percentile of that seed's own replicates

123.resampling: donor-stratified, cells with replacement within donor
123.ci_method: per-seed percentile of that seed's own replicates

456.resampling: donor-stratified, cells with replacement within donor
456.ci_method: per-seed percentile of that seed's own replicates

averaged_ci95.method: arithmetic mean of the per-seed bootstrap bounds (ci_lower and ci_upper of each seed)
averaged_ci95.note: an interval for the three-seed average under the convention used for the frozen - naive contrast; it is not a coverage-calibrated interval for the mean

across_seed.method: two-sided 95% t-interval on the seed means (t = mean of per-seed deltas, SE = sample SD over seeds / sqrt(n_seeds))

pooled.method: percentile of the pooled donor-stratified paired replicates: the per-seed replicate arrays are concatenated and the 2.5th/97.5th percentiles taken once over the union
pooled.resampling: one index vector per replicate, cells drawn with replacement within donor and applied to both arms
pooled.bound_convention: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the pooled replicate distribution
